summary: DUKE Robotics Corp. filed an 8-K announcing the appointment of Yiftach Kleinman as CEO, effective no later than September 8, 2026, replacing Yossi Balucka who remains President. The change is a planned succession, not forced or abrupt, given the 90-day transition window. Kleinman's employment agreement provides a gross monthly base salary of NIS 80,000 (approx. $27,600) plus annual bonus potential. The filing is an Item 5.02 disclosure of a management change; no transaction, activist, or restructuring is involved. The departure of Balucka as CEO is part of a planned transition, not a sudden event, so this is a routine management change.
